round2Resolutions.evidence: The schema now admits only 'system_u:object_r:[a-z0-9_]+_t:s0' for files[].selinuxLabel and backendFiles[].selinuxLabel, and the model compares type fields (_type) in the entrypoint, backend exec and interpreter rules and in both parts of the in-set census. With canonical labels, type equality is the same as string equality. All six round-2 spelling probes (another user, an MCS category, role system_r on a planeon and on a backend file, an MCS interpreter type, range s0-s0) are refused by the schema pattern under check_record and check_qualification. The exact-constant control is refused by the census, and an ordinary library in its own type is accepted (A16). N192-N200 pin these, each a single schema error. The README's 'cannot declare a second entry file ... under any spelling' is now true.

By code reading: entry_files is seeded with all eight backend exec types, read from the schema's backendComponents constants (schema digest-pinned by _shape before use) and mapped to None, so a file whose type belongs to an absent component is refused. It cannot be reached in data under v4: the only backend profile's componentKeys const lists all eight. The README records it as a successor guard.
The I06 v3 README title, the status lines and the briefs now say round 3.

builderReadingAssessed.reading: No path-conditional schema rules for executable files; the fixed types are enforced by the model through the executableLabel and interpreterLabel constants
builderReadingAssessed.reason: The constants are schema consts, so the type is closed in the schema as design §3.4/D1-13 requires. The model compares each subject's executable file with its constant, and the interpreted closures' executable-segment files with interpreterLabel. Labels are canonical, so the comparison is exact, and it is reachable and pinned (N63-N66, N68-N70, N75, N76). For backends a path-conditional rule is impossible, because their executable paths are data, not schema constants. For planeon roles it would only duplicate the model rule and make it unreachable. Coverage is complete: every enrolled file is owned by some closure (v3), each subject executable's type is fixed, and the census refuses any other file carrying an entrypoint, exec or interpreter type.

wholeStringCaptureEqualitiesAssessed.reason: After v4 removed the declared labels from captures, the only capture-to-record label comparisons left are processLabel: the inspected process and each member against the role's record processLabel, and each backend capture against its component's processLabel. Each of these record values is a schema const. Equality with a constant only refuses: a variant spelling of the right type fails closed and is never accepted. No rule accepts on capture-label inequality. domainProcessCounts are keyed by type, and backend-domain separation uses the type field or per-component constants. The record-side whole-string checks (roleCgroup, pin and seal-marker labels, processLabel) also compare with constants.
